Data sources & method

Arrival and departure windows follow the weekly BirdTrack reporting-rate and occurrence patterns shown in BTO BirdFacts. The Wormwood Scrubs 2024/25 RSPB and idverde report provides local evidence for the added species; a record in that one survey year does not establish annual regularity or guarantee a sighting in every listed month. Breeding status is shown only where the report confirms or assesses it. Country names are likely examples of origins or destinations, not tracked routes for individual birds.

Actual records come from valid eBird reports at hotspots inside the Hammersmith & Fulham boundary. The daily feed includes Hammersmith (LBC District), Furnival Gardens and Hammersmith Cemetery / Magravine Cemetery, plus other in-borough hotspots with recent reports. Notable and rarity records appear in Local sightings only; they do not add birds to the expected Arrivals or Departures tables. A sighting confirms a report at a place and date; it does not by itself confirm breeding or migration.

The NBN Atlas source list below uses the supplied, borough-confirmed occurrence export for birds recorded from 2016–2025. NBN coverage is incomplete, so it is used only to show recorded bird taxa and is not used to select or predict monthly arrivals and departures. Record totals count occurrences, not individual birds; absence from this archive is not evidence a bird was absent. Dataset providers, licences and required attributions are listed in the source credits.

Sources: BTO BirdFacts · BTO BirdTrack · eBird · NBN Atlas · Wormwood Scrubs ecological monitoring report 2024/25.
